evals.prompt: Improve these repository instructions. AGENTS.md says npm test, but package.json exposes only check and build. CLAUDE.md contains a duplicate copy. Codex and Claude Code both use the repo.
evals.expected_output: Correct the command, preserve unique instructions in AGENTS.md, and remove the duplicate CLAUDE.md without creating a wrapper.
assertions: Uses the manifest-backed check command
Keeps one authoritative instruction source
Applies the requested improvement without a second approval
Uses native Claude Code AGENTS.md support and checks fallback blockers

evals.prompt: Audit, without editing, an AGENTS.md that lists a missing scripts/deploy.sh and says always write descriptive variable names.
evals.expected_output: Report the broken path and redundant coaching with proposed changes.
assertions: Leaves files unchanged
Identifies the missing executable path
Distinguishes repository contracts from generic coding advice

evals.prompt: Migrate this repository to AGENTS.md only. Root CLAUDE.md is a symlink to AGENTS.md, packages/api/CLAUDE.md has unique rules, and .claude/CLAUDE.md exists. A gitignored CLAUDE.local.md holds private notes.
evals.expected_output: Remove the duplicate symlink safely, migrate scoped content, inspect the hidden project blocker, and keep private notes out of shared files while explaining the fallback mode exception.
assertions: Does not delete the symlink target
Preserves unique instructions and nested scope
Does not copy private notes into shared AGENTS.md
Explains that project CLAUDE.local.md blocks default fallback and both-files mode supports retaining it

evals.prompt: Set this repo up so Claude Code and Codex share our project skills. skills/triage-errors/SKILL.md calls PostHog MCP tools to fetch the top error, and only the Claude Code setup has that MCP server. AGENTS.md also repeats the triage steps the skill holds.
evals.expected_output: Flag that triage-errors depends on an MCP server only one tool has, either keep it out of the shared set or name the dependency in its description, and leave one copy of the triage steps with a pointer in the other file.
assertions: Identifies the PostHog MCP dependency as a capability Codex lacks
Keeps the skill out of the shared set or names the MCP dependency in its description
Does not claim the skill works unchanged in Codex
Removes the duplicated triage steps from one file and leaves a pointer

evals.prompt: Our AGENTS.md keeps growing. It's 260 lines now, about forty of them are 'Update (Sept):' or 'we used to use Jest, now Vitest' notes under older rules, and there are 14 skills in .claude/skills. Get it back under control and stop it creeping again.
evals.expected_output: Size Budget measurements taken before and after (root lines, launch-path bytes, project skill description bytes); a Refactor that rewrites each dated or 'used to' note into the current rule and deletes the history; directory-specific detail moved to nested AGENTS.md files; skills that duplicate root reduced to one copy; a root at or under 150 lines; and the one-in, one-out rule stated as how the file stays under budget.
assertions: Reports root line count and launch-path byte total both before and after the edit
Reports the project skill description size per tool (.claude/skills and .agents/skills) as part of the always-loaded cost
The edited root AGENTS.md contains no dated entry and no 'previously' or 'used to' note
The edited root AGENTS.md is 150 lines or fewer, or the report names each remaining line over budget and why it stays
The edited root AGENTS.md contains a one-line rule that an addition at or over budget removes or moves a line
